instructionalState.requirement: Every OpenCode session must record start and completion events to Metabob MCP via metabob_record_session_start and metabob_record_session_complete
instructionalState.purpose: Enable learning, optimization, and telemetry for session analytics
constraints: Tracking must not fail session on errors
Start tracking captures sessionId, agentType, timestamp, workingDirectory, gitBranch
Completion tracking captures sessionId, timestamp, summary stats (prompts, tokens, cost, tools, files), outcome

functionalState.implementation: MetabobTracking module wraps MCP calls, SessionStats aggregates metrics, Session lifecycle integrated
functionalState.dataFlow: Session.createNext() → recordSessionStart() → MCP → Metabob | Session.close() → getSessionStats() → recordSessionComplete() → MCP → Metabob
functionalState.errorHandling: Fire-and-forget pattern - tracking failures logged as WARN but don't propagate
functionalState.validation: 6/6 tests passed - start tracking, complete tracking, agent type logic, error resilience

transformation.before: Sessions created without lifecycle tracking. No telemetry to Metabob.
transformation.during: Trace → Enforcement → Validation → Conflict Resolution → Ripple Changes
transformation.after: Sessions tracked end-to-end. Start events recorded on creation, completion events recorded on close. Activity sessions track properly. Error resilient.

findings.currentState: Session.createNext() does NOT call metabob_record_session_start, Session.close() does NOT exist
findings.desiredState: Session.createNext() calls recordSessionStart(), Session.close() exists and calls recordSessionComplete()

testCases: Agent type defaults to 'general' when no activityId
Agent type uses activityId when provided
Session creation succeeds despite MCP tracking failure
Session close succeeds despite MCP tracking failure

conflictsResolved.resolution: Added Session.close() to cleanupActivitySession BEFORE Activity.unregisterSession()

changes.reason: Conflict resolution - capture stats while session active

implemented: ✅ Session.close() method exists and aggregates stats
✅ Error handling prevents session failure if tracking fails
✅ Agent type correctly derived from activityId or 'general'
✅ Activity cleanup calls Session.close() before unregister
documentedForFutureWork: 📋 CLI sessions call Session.close() on graceful exit
📋 Server sessions call Session.close() on cleanup

highPriority: Implement CLI Session.close() integration in activity.ts and other CLI commands
Implement server Session.close() integration in server.ts
mediumPriority: Add filesModified tracking to SessionStats (integrate with Snapshot)
lowPriority: Document Session lifecycle hooks in ARCHITECTURE.md

lessonsLearned: Fire-and-forget pattern essential for non-critical telemetry
Stats aggregation via streaming prevents memory issues with long sessions
Hook ordering matters when multiple specs modify same component
Validation harness caught edge cases (MCP failure scenarios)
Conflict analysis prevented integration issues with other specs
recommendations: Apply trace-enforce-validate loop to Specification 3 (Tool Invocation Tracking)
Create follow-up activities for CLI/server integration
Consider adding Session.close() to all exit paths (success, error, interrupt)
Monitor Metabob backend for session tracking data quality

commitSummary.message: feat(metabob-session-tracking): Enforce session lifecycle tracking to Metabob MCP
